bullets.title: NVDA: Oppenheimer downgrades to Perform, Craig-Hallum to Hold on Jensen Huang departure
bullets.body: Oppenheimer removed its Outperform and $315 PT, calling Huang "irreplaceable" with 50+ direct reports and no clear successor — brain-drain risk seen as the key overhang despite near-term fundamentals (F3Q DC sales +14% Q/Q to $101.8B, GM bottoming at 71.7%). Craig-Hallum also cut to Hold with a $189 PT vs. stock at $164.58. Both notes flag leadership uncertainty as an extended share overhang even as beat-and-raise is still expected in the upcoming print.

bullets.title: NVDA: Export control risk sharply elevated post-Huang scandal
bullets.body: Wolfe and IFP both flag that Huang's departure materially raises odds of Congressional export control legislation (MATCH Act, AI OVERWATCH Act, Chip Security Act) passing via the NDAA by year-end. Huang had been the key moderating influence on Trump's chip policy; his removal empowers hawkish voices like Rubio and Musk. Remote-access compute restrictions could cut China's AI capacity meaningfully — IFP forecasts remote access will be 1/3 of China's AI compute by end-2027. MATCH Act poses highest escalation risk with potential rare-earth retaliation.

bullets.title: NVDA: GS hosts emergency call; AMD, AVGO, MRVL flagged as beneficiaries
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs held a same-day virtual discussion on the NVDA management transition, covering strategy, ecosystem, and financial read-across. Oppenheimer explicitly names AMD, AVGO (TPU/Google), and MRVL (Trainium) as beneficiaries of any NVDA execution stumble. NVDA is down 7% YTD vs. SOX +49% and trades at 7x CY28E EPS vs. its 21x/25x three/five-year averages.

bullets.title: AMAT: Mizuho Outperform, $590 PT; Nov 17 NYC investor day on 2027 WFE cycle
bullets.body: Mizuho maintains Outperform on Applied Materials with a $590 PT ahead of a Nov 17 NYC investor event. Focus areas include 2027 WFE outlook (tight supply, rising demand), CoPoS/EMIB-T advanced packaging, HBM-driven DRAM capacity adds, and potential NAND greenfield expansion in 2027 driven by SLC and AI workloads.

bullets.title: Fast inference call Nov 18: NVDA, AMD, AVGO, MU, SNDK in scope
bullets.body: Mizuho hosting a Nov 18 virtual call with a senior architect at a private ASIC supplier to discuss fast-inference market TAM to 2030, the role of SRAM/DRAM/HBM in decode, and potentially shorter XPU lifecycles. Key names flagged: NVDA, AMD, AVGO, MU, SNDK.

bullets.title: MSFT: Jefferies BUY, $650 PT; webinar Dec 9
bullets.body: Jefferies analyst Brent Thill reaffirms Buy on Microsoft with a $650 price target; investor webinar scheduled for December 9 at 12:30 PM ET. No change in thesis disclosed beyond the event notice.

bullets.title: NET: Structural seat-based model pressure flagged from AI agents
bullets.body: 20VC panel (O'Driscoll/Lemkin) highlights Cloudflare as facing structural pressure as AI agents erode seat-based SaaS economics. CrowdStrike and cybersecurity infrastructure broadly seen as beneficiaries of rising attacks on AI systems.

bullets.title: SPOT/AAPL/AMZN: Roth tracking SiriusXM churn shift to streaming
bullets.body: Roth MKM deploying a 1,000-consumer survey (Volume 8) measuring SiriusXM subscriber churn, price elasticity, and in-car listening shift toward streaming-only plans. SPOT, AAPL, and AMZN named as competitive read-across; no ratings actions disclosed.
